description: Implementation of internal flag handling in the Abseil library, including flag state management, parsing, validation, and callback mechanisms.

classes.name: FlagState
classes.description: Represents a saved state of a flag, allowing restore operations.

classes.name: FlagImpl
classes.description: Implements internal flag logic, including value storage, parsing, validation, and callback handling.

classes.name: DynValueDeleter
classes.description: Custom deleter for dynamically allocated flag values.

classes.name: MutexRelock
classes.description: Helper class to temporarily unlock and relock a mutex.

methods.name: FlagState::Restore
methods.description: Restores the flag to the saved state.

methods.name: FlagImpl::Init
methods.description: Initializes the flag's internal state.

methods.name: FlagImpl::DataGuard
methods.description: Returns a mutex for thread-safe access to flag data.

methods.name: FlagImpl::AssertValidType
methods.description: Checks that the flag's runtime type matches its declared type.

methods.name: FlagImpl::MakeInitValue
methods.description: Creates a new initial value for the flag.

methods.name: FlagImpl::StoreValue
methods.description: Stores a new value into the flag.

methods.name: FlagImpl::Name
methods.description: Returns the flag's name.

methods.name: FlagImpl::Filename
methods.description: Returns the filename where the flag is defined.

methods.name: FlagImpl::Help
methods.description: Returns the help message for the flag.

methods.name: FlagImpl::TypeId
methods.description: Returns the type ID of the flag.

methods.name: FlagImpl::ModificationCount
methods.description: Returns the number of modifications made to the flag.

methods.name: FlagImpl::IsSpecifiedOnCommandLine
methods.description: Checks if the flag was set via command line.

methods.name: FlagImpl::DefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value of the flag as a string.

methods.name: FlagImpl::CurrentValue
methods.description: Returns the current value of the flag as a string.

methods.name: FlagImpl::SetCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback to be invoked on flag mutation.

methods.name: FlagImpl::InvokeCallback
methods.description: Invokes the mutation callback if set.

methods.name: FlagImpl::SaveState
methods.description: Saves the current state of the flag.

methods.name: FlagImpl::RestoreState
methods.description: Restores the flag to a previously saved state.

methods.name: FlagImpl::TryParse

methods.description: Reads the current value of the flag into a destination buffer.

methods.name: FlagImpl::ReadOneWord
methods.description: Reads the flag's value as a single word.

methods.name: FlagImpl::ReadOneBool
methods.description: Reads the flag's value as a boolean.

methods.name: FlagImpl::ReadSequenceLockedData
methods.description: Reads data protected by a sequence lock.

methods.description: Writes a new value into the flag.

methods.description: Verifies that default value parsing and unparsing are consistent.
